english: but I did not write a single card!
text: 这里不说 I did not write any cards，而说 did not write a single card，是用“连一张都没有”加强语气。想强调数量少到极点、一个都没达成时，用 not a single + 可数名词，比 not any 的语气更突出。
author: doubao-seed-2-1-turbo-260628
